title: Ocean predators
text: The ocean is full of life, but it is also full of hunters. A predator is an animal that hunts and eats other animals. In the sea there are some amazing predators.

The great white shark is the most famous. It is longer than a car and it has about three hundred teeth. It can smell a drop of blood from very far away. But sharks attack people very rarely. Fishing is more dangerous for sharks than sharks are for us.
The orca, or killer whale, is bigger and stronger than the great white shark. Orcas live and hunt in family groups. They are very intelligent and they work as a team. Sometimes they even hunt sharks!
The saltwater crocodile lives near the coast in Asia and Australia. It is heavier than a small car. It waits without moving in the water and then it attacks very fast.
Some ocean predators are tiny. The cone snail is smaller than your hand, but it has a dangerous venom. Be careful when you walk on the beach!

grammar.title: Grammar: comparatives
grammar.rule: To compare two things, use adjective + -er + than. With long adjectives use more + adjective + than.
items: The orca is ___ than the shark.
A shark is ___ than a car.
The crocodile is ___ than a small car.
Fishing is ___ for sharks than sharks are for us.
The snail is ___ than your hand.
